title: Four Blue Palms - Vacation Rental in Seacrest Beach West,FL | 30a Escapes
meta_description: 30A ESCAPES presents…“Four Blue Palms”, A luxurious 5,000 sq. ft. coastal retreat in Seacrest West, made for large families and celebratory getaways. With five king en-suites, two oversized bunk rooms, and a full arcade-style game room, there’s room for everyone
description_expanded: 30A ESCAPES presents…“Four Blue Palms”, A luxurious 5,000 sq. ft. coastal retreat in Seacrest West, made for large families and celebratory getaways. With five king en-suites, two oversized bunk rooms, and a full arcade-style game room, there’s room for everyone to relax and play. Outside, unwind beside the massive private pool, take in Gulf breezes from expansive balconies, or stroll just two minutes to the deeded beach access. Whether you’re savoring sunset cocktails, poolside lounging, or biking to Alys and Rosemary Beach, this home delivers the ultimate 30A experience.*** HIGHLIGHTS ***Spacious & Luxe Living – 5 King master en-suites + 2 bunk rooms sleep up to 30 guests in total comfortSteps from the Beach – Just a 2-minute walk to private deeded beach accessHuge Private Pool – With ample lounge space and shaded areasGulf-View Balconies – Multiple furnished balconies ideal for coffee at sunrise or cocktails at sunsetUltimate Game Room – Foosball, arcade machines, dual TVs & space to spread outElevator Access – Skip the stairs with smooth transitions across all three floorsChef-Ready Kitchen – Dual fridges, ovens, dishwashers & seating for the whole crewPet Friendly – Bring your four-legged family membersPrime Location – 5-minute bike ride to Alys Beach, Rosemary Beach, & The Big Chill*** LIVING AREAS ***Comfy main living area with easy pool accessLarge Smart TV for group movie
